existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Charges not to exceed actual cost incurred
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A public body may make reasonable charges not to exceed its actual cost incurred in accessing, duplicating, supplying, or searching for the requested records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: ceiling: actual cost incurred in accessing/duplicating/supplying/searching
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: a public body may make reasonable charges not to exceed its actual cost incurred in accessing, duplicating, supplying, or searching for the requested records and shall make all reasonable efforts to supply the requested records at the lowest possible cost.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: State sets a ceiling (actual cost); the city sets its actual per-request charge under it. No statewide fixed per-page rate exists.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Duty to supply at lowest possible cost
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The body shall make all reasonable efforts to supply the requested records at the lowest possible cost.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Body sets charges for a request
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: and shall make all reasonable efforts to supply the requested records at the lowest possible cost.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: No public body shall impose extraneous, intermediary, or surplus fees or expenses to recoup the general costs of creating or maintaining records or transacting the general business of the public body.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: No public body shall impose any extraneous, intermediary, or surplus fees or expenses to recoup the general costs associated with creating or maintaining records or transacting the general business of the public body.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Duplicating fee not to exceed actual cost of duplication
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Any duplicating fee charged by a public body shall not exceed the actual cost of duplication.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Any duplicating fee charged by a public body shall not exceed the actual cost of duplication.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Pre-search written notice of possible charges
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Prior to conducting a search for records, the body shall notify the requester in writing that it may make reasonable charges not to exceed actual cost and inquire whether the requester would like a cost estimate in advance.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Before conducting a search for records
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Prior to conducting a search for records, the public body shall notify the requester in writing that the public body may make reasonable charges not to exceed its actual cost incurred in accessing, duplicating, supplying, or searching for requested records and inquire of the requester whether he would like to request a cost estimate in advance of the supplying of the requested records.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The public body shall provide the requester with a cost estimate if requested.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester asks for a cost estimate
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The public body shall provide the requester with a cost estimate if requested.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Estimating cost credited toward overall charges
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Any costs incurred by the public body in estimating the cost of supplying the records shall be applied toward the overall charges to be paid by the requester.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Body incurs cost preparing a cost estimate
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Any costs incurred by the public body in estimating the cost of supplying the requested records shall be applied toward the overall charges to be paid by the requester for the supplying of such requested records.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Local body may offer an electronic method of payment
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Any local public body that charges for producing records may provide an electronic method of payment (noncash, non-paper-check — credit/debit cards, direct deposit/debit, electronic checks, telephonic payment).
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Local public body charges for record production
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Any local public body that charges for the production of records pursuant to this section may provide an electronic method of payment through which all payments for the production of such records to such locality may be made.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Advance deposit when charges likely to exceed $200
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Where a public body determines in advance that charges are likely to exceed $200, it may, before continuing to process the request, require the requester to pay a deposit not to exceed the amount of the advance determination.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Advance determination that charges are likely to exceed $200
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: fixed threshold: $200; deposit ceiling = the advance-determination amount
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: In any case where a public body determines in advance that charges for producing the requested records are likely to exceed $200, the public body may, before continuing to process the request, require the requester to pay a deposit not to exceed the amount of the advance determination.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: $200 is a state-fixed trigger threshold; the deposit itself is capped at the body's advance determination (a ceiling).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: No charge for FERPA scholastic records to parent/guardian/eligible student
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The reasonable-charge fee provisions do not apply to scholastic records that must be made available under FERPA when requested by a parent or legal guardian of a minor student or by a student who is 18 or older.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Request for scholastic records under § 2.2-3705.4(A)(1) by parent/guardian or student 18+
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Except with regard to scholastic records requested pursuant to subdivision A 1 of § 2.2-3705.4 that must be made available for inspection pursuant to the federal Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (20 U.S.C. § 1232g) and such requests for scholastic records by a parent or legal guardian of a minor student or by a student who is 18 years of age or older, a public body may make reasonable charges ...
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Special-record fee treatment: carves this class out of the § 2.2-3704(F) charge regime.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Charge for GIS records to non-owner; topo map pro rata
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A body may make a reasonable charge, not exceeding actual cost, for records produced from a geographic information system at the request of anyone other than the owner of the subject land, except that it may charge on a pro rata per-acre basis for topographical maps it developed that encompass a contiguous area greater than 50 acres.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Request for GIS-produced records by a non-owner of the subject land
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: ceiling: actual cost; exception — pro rata per-acre for body-developed topo maps over 50 contiguous acres
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The public body may also make a reasonable charge for the cost incurred in supplying records produced from a geographic information system at the request of anyone other than the owner of the land that is the subject of the request. However, such charges shall not exceed the actual cost to the public body in supplying such records, except that the public body may charge, on a pro rata per acre basis, for the cost of creating topographical maps developed by the public body, for such maps or portions thereof, which encompass a contiguous area greater than 50 acres.
